critical_code_review_comments: ManageClasses.js catches errors with empty `catch {}` blocks (loadClasses/loadBatches) — silently swallows failures; should log or toast on batch-load failure to help future debugging.

StudentClasses.js loadClasses swallows all errors silently and still sets loading=false, so a failing GET /student/classes/my-classes shows the empty state instead of an error. This is exactly the kind of thing that produced the reported false symptom — recommend surfacing errors.

rca of the issue: Not reproducible.
